name: Emberkin (Example)
author: voodoo573
description: EXAMPLE ITEM. Emberkin are small, warm-blooded folk said to have been born from the first hearth fire. They carry a gentle inner glow and are welcome guests in any cold mountain village.
summary: Example race: small hearth-born folk with a warm inner glow.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: See in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light.

traits.name: Hearth-Warmed
traits.desc: Resistance to cold damage. You are comfortable in cold weather down to -20 degrees Fahrenheit.

traits.name: Kindle
traits.desc: You know the Light cantrip. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for it.

racialAbilities.name: Warming Glow
racialAbilities.desc: Bonus action: one creature you touch gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Ashwalker
traits.desc: Proficiency in Survival. Smoke and soot never obscure your vision.

traits.name: Quickfire
traits.desc: Your walking speed increases to 30 feet.
